# Loop If Condition Is False

Source: [4391](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4391); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Loop If Condition Is False](../../api/actions/loop-if-condition-is-false.md).

<a id="wiki-4391-n1"></a>

- Loop If Condition Is False restarts the whole action list if any rule condition is false; it requires an executed Wait since list start.
